summary: Critical outage in web-frontend caused by bad_deploy (INC-0031)
description: Service web-frontend incident INC-0031. Symptoms: CrashLoopBackOff on service pods. Error: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'payments.v2.client'. Root cause was bad_deploy. Followed runbook RB-bad-deploy-rollback.

comments.author: devops1
comments.body: Restarted service pods for web-frontend and applied RB-bad-deploy-rollback.
